name: Lingarr
description: Lingarr translates subtitles in your Radarr and Sonarr libraries. It watches for media without subtitles in the languages you want and translates existing ones automatically, using either a self-hosted LibreTranslate instance or a hosted provider such as DeepL, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini.

notes.text: Set a translation backend in /opt/lingarr.env before use. The default points at a LibreTranslate instance that does not exist yet - either deploy one and set LIBRE_TRANSLATE_URL, or switch SERVICE_TYPE to a hosted provider and add its API key.
Mount your media libraries into the LXC and connect Radarr/Sonarr through the web UI. Lingarr writes subtitle files next to the media, so it needs write access to those paths.

Needs the .NET 10 SDK, which Debian does not ship - it comes from the Microsoft repository. The build is therefore large; the compiled output lands in /opt/lingarr_app while the source tree stays in /opt/lingarr.
Metadata is stored in the local PostgreSQL database 'lingarr'. Upstream also supports MySQL and SQLite via DB_CONNECTION.
